verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
OBWAKABAKA bwo bujje
Kaakano tukyogedde:
Yesu onjigirize
-Okukisabira ddala.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Yesu,sooka oyigire
Muno mu mwoyo gwange:
Naakusembeza gye ndi,
Ongobemu ebibi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ombeerenga bulijjo
Mbuulire-ekigambo kyo;
Olyoke ojje nate,
Mu mwoyo gya bannange.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ebiro bwe biriggwaawo-;
Kitaawo bye yalaga,
Olijja n'ettendo lyo,
N'olya-obwakabaka bwo
